title: Outside Day Follow-Through
summary: Of the sessions that traded beyond BOTH the prior session's high and low, how often the NEXT session closed green. The denominator is outside sessions with a next session on record; the numerator is the ones whose next session closed above its own open. Outside sessions are rare by construction, so expect a small N and let the guard banners carry the appropriate weight.
deltas: the exact complement design of inside-day, so the two read on one scale
next-session return distribution attached alongside the rate
minimum-N guards refuse to dress up a thin sample
